title: Dubai CAMS dust -> short IAG.L
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Dubai CAMS dust 20d z-score > 1.5 (direct dust proxy rather than total AOD) marks sandstorm days that disrupt Gulf hub flights (-); trade short IAG.L 2d at 1d lag [airquality.dubai.cams_dust -> finance.IAG.L.log_return] (parent: R2-0070)
message: Not supported as correlation (r=-0.01, n=389, validity 0) but trade rule: short IAG.L 1d on dust z>1, 46 trades hit 54%, OOS 16 trades hit 75%, actionability 7.3; likely war-regime common cause

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.dubai.cams_dust rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short IAG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: Dubai CAMS dust 20d z-score > 1 shorting LHA.DE 1d at 1d lag should show weaker OOS hit rate than IAG.L (75% on 16 trades) if the effect is Gulf-hub specific rather than a war-regime artifact (-) [airquality.dubai.cams_dust -> finance.LHA.DE.log_return] (parent: R2-0168)
